title: Scene gallery — real-table, shipped 600
description: The 600 build sheets delivered to hardware, 100 per tier per horizon. Tiered from the original search sweep. Kept as shipped; the full exhaustive pool is the other card.

title: Scene gallery — real-table, full exhaustive pool
description: Every exhaustively labelled real-table scene, both horizons, ONE movable block each. The two-movable rooms are the other card, and nothing here has a second block to interact with. Tiers come from pure depth-2 enumeration (every first push ends in a finish or a proven dead end), not from the search sweep, so the solve rates differ from the shipped 600. Counts are not written here on purpose; the live line above is read from the index.

title: Scene gallery — real-table, two movable blocks
description: 2180 exhaustively labelled two-movable doorways, filtered to the ones that earn their keep: a push that opens the region AND actually shoves the second block. Every card here can step through its own solution; cards whose recorded solution does not replay from a clean start are left out. Difficulty is per horizon, so 1push is scored on openers over enumerated pushes and 2push on openers plus setups, both against the usual 5%/30% cuts. Cards say when the doorway needs both blocks and whether a route around it exists, and a step-through says whether the solve merged the two regions or reached the goal through a gap. Both count as solved.
